# sauth_claim (Resource)

The claim records of the service, through its state import and export



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `access` (Number) access bits: owner 1, write 2, read 4, execute 8, deny 16, member 32
- `key` (String) the record key, its identity in the service and in references
- `name` (String) name
- `owner_id` (String) owner id

### Optional

- `description` (String) description
- `inherits` (Boolean) inherits
- `level` (Number) level
- `type` (String) claim type
